about: INVENTED cases (clubs, players and outlets do not exist) for situations the real data of 2026-10-20 did not have. They show how the grouping code treats a described situation; they are not evidence of how often it happens. Scored apart from the real pairs and never mixed into their numbers. No story cards: only the word grouping can join them.
